skill.name: security-compliance-compliance-check
skill.description: Assess software compliance readiness for GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and related regulatory frameworks.
skill.summary: Build compliance gap analyses, control plans, evidence lists, and audit preparation guidance.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Software teams need clear evidence before they claim compliance readiness. This skill maps requirements to controls, gaps, implementation steps, and audit artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Maps application features to GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, and PCI DSS requirements.
Creates gap analyses with severity ratings and practical remediation steps.
Outlines technical controls for privacy, access control, encryption, logging, and monitoring.
Identifies audit evidence, documentation needs, and policy artifacts.
Drafts implementation roadmaps for compliance readiness work.
limitations: Does not provide legal advice or formal compliance certification.
Requires accurate scope, systems, data flows, and control evidence from the user.
Cannot verify production controls without access to approved evidence.
Regulatory interpretations must be reviewed by qualified legal or audit professionals.

use_cases.title: Prepare a SaaS Audit
use_cases.description: Map product controls to SOC 2 criteria and identify missing evidence before an external audit.

use_cases.title: Review Healthcare Data Controls
use_cases.description: Assess HIPAA safeguards for protected health information and prioritize technical remediation.

use_cases.title: Plan Privacy Compliance Work
use_cases.description: Translate GDPR rights, consent, retention, and breach requirements into engineering tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Applicable Frameworks
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this product description and data flow. Identify which compliance frameworks may apply and explain the evidence needed for each one.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Gap Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess our current controls against GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, and PCI DSS. List gaps, severity, business impact, and recommended next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Implementation Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this compliance gap analysis into a prioritized 90-day implementation roadmap with owners, milestones, verification steps, and audit evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Design Continuous Monitoring
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a continuous compliance monitoring process for these controls. Include metrics, alert conditions, evidence retention, and reporting cadence.

output_examples.input: Assess GDPR readiness for a web application that stores user profiles, analytics events, and marketing consent records.
output: A framework applicability summary for GDPR requirements.
A gap list covering consent, deletion, portability, retention, and breach response.
A prioritized implementation plan with evidence needed for audit review.

output_examples.input: Prepare SOC 2 evidence requests for access control, change management, and audit logging.
output: A list of missing policies, screenshots, approvals, and system reports.
A review cadence for keeping evidence current.

output_examples.input: Review HIPAA safeguards for a patient messaging feature.
output: A safeguard assessment for access, transmission security, audit logs, and minimum necessary access.
Recommended documentation for compliance and auditor review.

best_practices: Provide scope, data categories, systems, jurisdictions, and existing control evidence before requesting an assessment.
Validate recommendations with legal counsel, auditors, and control owners before claiming compliance.
Turn each gap into a tracked task with an owner, deadline, verification method, and evidence location.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated guidance as legal advice or certification.
Do not claim compliance when evidence is missing or controls are only planned.
Do not share regulated data, credentials, or production secrets in prompts.

faq.question: Which frameworks can this skill help with?
faq.answer: It focuses on GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and common security compliance practices.

faq.question: Can it certify that a product is compliant?
faq.answer: No. It helps with readiness work, but certification requires qualified auditors or legal professionals.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide scope, data flows, system architecture, control descriptions, policies, and available evidence.

faq.question: Can it create audit evidence?
faq.answer: It can identify needed evidence and draft checklists, but actual evidence must come from your systems and processes.

faq.question: Does it replace legal review?
faq.answer: No. Use it for technical planning and preparation, then confirm legal interpretations with qualified counsel.

faq.question: Can it help after an audit finding?
faq.answer: Yes. It can convert findings into remediation plans, owners, verification steps, and documentation updates.
